findings.title: Renamed helpers `mark_failed_threshold` and `create_issue_platform_occurrence` are removed with no call-site updates in this PR
findings.body: The PR deletes `mark_failed_threshold` and `create_issue_platform_occurrence` from `mark_failed.py` and replaces them with `try_incident_threshold` and `create_incident_occurrence` in new modules. Nothing in the changed files shows the other callers or tests being updated. Any remaining import of the old names, or any `mock.patch("sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed.create_issue_platform_occurrence")`-style patch in the test suite, will fail with ImportError or AttributeError. The PR should either update every reference in the repo or keep backward-compatible aliases until they are gone.

findings.title: `SimpleCheckIn` moved out of `mark_failed.py`; old import path no longer exists
findings.body: `SimpleCheckIn` was defined in `sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed` and is now defined in `sentry.monitors.types`. Code that does `from sentry.monitors.logic.mark_failed import SimpleCheckIn` will break. The PR does not show a search for such imports or a re-export.

findings.title: No tests are added or updated for the moved and renamed logic
findings.body: The PR moves about 250 lines of incident and occurrence logic into two new modules and renames the entry point, but adds no test changes in the diff. Tests that exercise the threshold and occurrence paths should be confirmed to still pass against the new module paths. Any mocks that patch the old module-level names will need updating.

findings.title: Docstring typo: "humam readible"
findings.body: The docstring of `get_failure_reason` reads "Builds a humam readible string". This is copied verbatim into the new module, so the typo is now in a fresh file. It should be "human readable".
